_howto: One item per paper figure/table (or panel group). This file is the machine-readable coverage contract:
decision for numeric items: target (with target_ids) | deferred_blocked (with blocker).
decision for non_numeric items: excluded | target.
Allowed blockers: missing_author_data, missing_benchmark_metadata, missing_source_input, insufficient_compute, requires_external_hardware, covered_by_target, user_descoped.
'Supporting', 'low priority', or 'similar to another figure' are NOT blockers: reproduce the item instead.
Coverage means scientific reproduction (independent numerics or analytic references). Digitized curves and copied source panels do not count as coverage.
If compute or data is genuinely insufficient, deferred_blocked with an honest reason is the correct final state; do not fake coverage.
